title: Trim Close-Up Photos by Cabin Trim — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
**Rule.** The trim close-ups of a Cleaning and Damage Fees approval photo set are read from the reported trip's ride option: Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV, whose cabins are leather, add the leather trim close-ups; Wayfare Comfort adds the cloth trim close-ups; any other ride option adds no trim close-ups.

The leather trim close-ups are 2 photos and the cloth trim close-ups are 1 photo, and they are added to the approval photo set. The ride option is the one on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) for the trip the report is on.

| Ride option | Cabin trim | Trim close-ups |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black | leather | 2 |
| Wayfare Black SUV | leather | 2 |
| Wayfare Comfort | cloth | 1 |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard, Wayfare Green or Wayfare XL | — | none |

The number of trim close-ups does not depend on the seats requested or on the incident reported. A report on a Wayfare XL trip, for example, adds no trim close-ups even though Wayfare XL is a three-row vehicle.
